scope.kind: read-only source inventory and integration/performance audit
scope.human_requirement: A cliff art piece supports a floor on an authored specific side at a specific physical height. This causal construction/contact relationship is distinct from independently assigning Tile.height plus a generic wall; it is not load/collapse engineering.
scope.authorization: Inventory only. The current XYZ proposal is not implementation authorization.
scope.interpretation_policy: Verified fields are copied or pointed to with their original qualifications. Null means no declaration established, not zero support. Candidate classification does not confer walkability, load-bearing, full-cell fill or cross-family compatibility.
scope.latest_user_priority: Python code is the gameplay truth: existing tile/wall/door/storage definitions and published states should generate authored editor data. Height/support and visual wall/door/stair adjacency must be coupled using actual source evidence. No new gameplay systems or optimized-runtime changes.

source_census.method: Finite catalog and active authoring documents, all rows assigned a disposition. JSON is parsed by record, never inferred from image filenames. Existing reviewed editor adapters are indexed as source evidence, not invented rules. Artwork/source archives are not re-copied or reclassified by visual guess.

catalog.scope_verbatim: Full vendor Fantasy pack, selected/reviewed modified banks, all 81 previously authored props, current arena kits and crowd sections. Desert and retired window-opening/VIP experiments excluded.

godot_authoring.note: The 12 catalog decals absent from library are present in surfaces; four Godot additions are spell/portal sources, inventoried separately below.

source_census.qualified_scope_limit: Complete within these explicit source catalogs/owners, including unused candidates and all listed arena subpieces. No claim that every file in every vendor archive has certified physical support metadata. Desert artwork is deferred/excluded by current asset policy; no invented desert terrain bindings.

Actual preserved fitted window/wall destruction meshes with original source-UV artwork, shared baked motion and per-view visibility. Exact to those authored proxy surfaces; not certification of vendor pixel-level fine3D or hidden geometry. Retained holdout cards are visibility-only and not receiving geometry. Sparse support2 silhouette edges are bounded receiving approximations, not actual measured center positions; original nearby source hit, offset and worlderror remain recorded. Per-view inferred visible receiving geometry. Existing source pixel rays, source depth/normals and packet bytes remain authoritative in source coordinates. The declared affine maps the actual fitted camera projection into the standard host image projection while keeping source Z=0 on host H=0. It includes a small explicit ground-view-depth stretch/shear, not one rigid/shared vendor model. This receiver does not redefine wall collision, hidden thickness, physical support center, adjacency, assembly, mount, sprite pivot or animation timing. Source proxy units have no independently certified native-cell/feet mapping; host receiver scale is derived from unchanged selected display registration. Original proxy fine-geometry and source-support gaps/edge qualifications remain. Complete mixed source/inferred lighting receiver. Previously supported packet RG/BA and support1/2 outside exact repair/rejected-source-pose masks are byte-identical; only existing uncovered material and explicitly rejected frame24 source-pose samples receive diagnostic support3. Repairs retain each actual own source face/UV/positive-alpha evidence or separately qualified own-component fitted receiver. Nearby actual source depth/normal is reconstructed on unchanged native pixel-centre rays; repair masks never add an aperture/body pixel or shrink authored material. Existing per-view inferred receiving crosswalk, original source scale, contacts, pivots, alpha, wall/insert/aftermath roles and complete clock remain unchanged. Support3 is provenance only, not a new renderer binding, exact vendor hidden geometry or collision.

integration_findings.finding: Selected G12/G13 authored upper support at rise2 survives in original world.json; Godot converter places upper_support_offset only in notes and build emits no rise/contact. Engine cliff builder returns DirectionalWall/WALL with movement-only channels and two occupied height bands; this is not a floor-support relationship.

placement.gd consumes upper_support_id for painter precedence. scenes.json includes hand-authored links (including stacked cliff segments). This neither validates generated floors nor implements engine support causality.

Editor G16=edge/G17=continuation has corner/mid/top/landing and shoulder support footprint; selected world G17 declares simpler three support offsets. Generated timber has12 measured fractional treads and an explicitly required upper landing. Preserve each declaration and reconcile differences before any adapter.

sources.symbol_or_text: # Stairs and ramps stay in the source

integration_findings.finding: WorldPlacementSpec defines footprint/occupied bands; WorldObjectSupport identifies existing Tiles receiving objects. Neither generates/sustains floors above an authored piece. Current battlefield elevation rows assign Tile support heights independently.

All725 library files were inspected. Only generated-timber-stair-flight carries a top-level support_profile. Receiving masks/labels, depth normals, inferred roof pitch and broad member envelopes are not certified hidden solids or tactical floor surfaces.

performance_audit.status: source complexity review only; no runtime measurements made

existing_boundaries.facts: Resolve declared source units, owner anchor, quarter/camera crosswalk, supported-side/height/area, corner ports and chosen variant before map construction. Validate source evidence rather than sampling art at runtime.
existing_boundaries.risk: Editor connected-component/causal propagation can inspect the authored graph; do not move it into per-step or per-observer work.

existing_boundaries.facts: Existing candidate resolves footprint supports/bands and validates collision; commit updates exact memberships. A future supported-floor relation would need similarly local maintained old/new contact membership, not a generic whole-map support manager.
existing_boundaries.risk: Do not re-run map-wide support closure on movement; edits must name affected old/new receiving cells/edges.

existing_boundaries.facts: Current XY dictionary supports, sorted bounded support columns, Tile object bands, local boundary candidates and settled edge answers are existing owners. Preserve path-domain locality and affordable search bounds.
existing_boundaries.risk: A floor query must not enumerate every asset, placement, support or remote level. Existing support columns are presently XY segments, not an implemented XYZ stack.

existing_boundaries.facts: Writers bump channels over changed cells, advance chunk traversal stamps and drop only cached solves whose read box intersects. Structured edges are rewritten for local cells/neighbors.
existing_boundaries.risk: Art edits/physical edits are different. Current set_tile_elevation bumps movement only; new optical slabs/support faces would require an explicit channel policy and dependent light/sensory invalidation, not reuse of movement-only invalidation.

existing_boundaries.facts: Reducer selects observers reaching changed cell boxes/holding contacts, batches shared world facts, retains contact table changes and navigation read stamps. Reuse committed local obstruction channels; no renderer sampling, per-target blocker scan or full-map propagation.
existing_boundaries.risk: Adding support geometry to every observer independently can multiply work by observers × asset/face count. Same-plane solver/corner behavior and local light dependencies need preserved outputs.

resolve_once_at_authoring_load_or_edit: chosen variant and explicit supported floor contacts/side/height
declared joins and local receiving support membership
exact local solid/barrier/channel facts and affected-old/new indices
forbidden_hot_path_work: new generic manager/framework or speculative cache
later_implementation_gates: Pair real flat command end-to-end latency on the same committed source/environment before/after; include commit, capture, projection, JSON, bytes and retained history; no unsupported zero-slowdown claim.
Vary unrelated remote map/library size independently of local geometry. Per-step cost and selected observer work must not grow with unrelated assets/floors.
Vary local overlapping supports/boundaries separately; account bounded candidate/edge reads and exact old/new invalidation, plus cancellation and removal.
Preserve planar movement costs/routes, hidden occupancy/privacy, FOV corner behavior, selected AoE preview/execution and local light delta outputs before accepting timing.
Measure authoring/load/edit work separately from gameplay; causal graph closure may be authoring work and must not be charged to every move.

data_that_must_survive_for_client_constr: Source asset/variant identity and qualification, not a new duplicate artwork registry.
Declared coordinate frame/lattice, units, anchor and camera-to-world quarter crosswalk.
Oriented boundary faces, exact rise, supported floor offset/footprint/contact height and any declared contact polygon; distinguish absent from unknown.
Stair contact roles and exact fractional/lattice points, lane continuation, edge/continuation identity, entry/top/landing support requirements.
Corner/join profile compatibility; do not flatten a convex two-contact corner to one cell or fill a concave notch.

Explicit placed support/source identities for causal validation and local edit invalidation; no pixel sampling or full-map graph solve on every move.
client_data_structures_and_preservation.bounded_followup: User priority is a bounded backend-definition/state export into the reopened editor, accompanied by explicit art-owned fit/contact evidence. Parent traces the existing Python -> snapshots/SDK -> authoring path. This audit proposes no new solver or gameplay implementation and changes no optimized path.

adjacency_and_backend_ownership_suppleme.scope: Narrow adjacency/WFC-principle evidence supplement to the existing finite census. Wall/door visual fit, height, support, stair lanes and landings are joint placement constraints, not cosmetic neighbor similarity. No new general solver or gameplay system designed.

ownership_boundary.facts: Existing content item IDs, Tile support height/surface/slope fields, boundary placement footprint/orientation/bands, blocked channels, door mechanism/open/swing/destruction and other published state. Export actual definitions/states; do not reconstruct them from art labels.

Specific source anchors, camera crosswalks, clear-opening visual geometry, header/partition/floor member stencils, permitted source variants and explicit forbidden substitutions. These annotate the backend IDs and keep source qualifications; they are not inferred gameplay rules.

causalHeight label regexes, formulas and fallbacks produce serialized elevationBoundary/elevationTraversal. They are existing implementation evidence, not automatically approved contact geometry or exported Python facts.

fantasy.ground.g16.qualification: Exact current adapter output; shoulder/topology formulas are not a new fit certificate. G16/G17 composed joins remain unapproved in the separate reviewed adjacency table.

fantasy.ground.g17.qualification: Exact current adapter output; shoulder/topology formulas are not a new fit certificate. G16/G17 composed joins remain unapproved in the separate reviewed adjacency table.

stair_connections.discrete_limits: E profile reaches centre landing(-2,0,z+2), shoulders(-1,-1,z+2)/(-1,1,z+2); G16 starts edge lane, G17 continues it. These values are current adapter declarations, not independent universal geometry approval. Selected world uses simpler three integer offsets; preserve and explicitly reconcile rather than silently substitute.

upper_landing.role: Separate support meets final tread at its exact continuous height; no landing exists in this sprite.

timber_profile.consumer_rule: Use this continuous-height support sequence as its own flight assembly. If the terrain storage has integer layers, store the measured fractional support height in the existing surface geometry/profile; do not round or stretch into G17/two-step stair contacts.

stair_connections.backend_rule_limit: Backend progressive movement semantics are existing gameplay truth; they do not by themselves prove visual art seams or select a compatible landing sprite.

actual_current_consumption_and_gaps.fact: Door converter retains source assembly variants/authoring record/pose offset in measurements.

Current build _door emits openings,destructions,frame_resource_by_pose only. measurements is checked as an asset, not turned into adjacency constraints. No active gd reader of assembly_variants/compatible_pieces/physical_mount was found outside converter.

actual_current_consumption_and_gaps.fact: Source slope definitions exist, but game mapping omits them; no current stair lane/landing construction consumer established.
upper_support_id and stairs/support_id affect painter precedence; they do not validate wall/door/stair adjacency or cause supported floor construction.

Arena constructor has family-specific area-contact/shared-profile/perimeter constraints and support ownership. These do not authorize arbitrary Fantasy asset attachments; production loader/curved adapter remain unconnected.

contradictions_missing_and_unsupported.issue: Modern own-source door physical_mount validation coexists with compatible_pieces compatibility_scope saying shared physical3D mounting not validated. Preserve separate claim scopes; own-source anchor checks do not upgrade every recovered cross-family seam/hidden collider.

Legacy S/N montage pivot offsets do not form a single measured source-floor anchor under the camera crosswalk; current physical mount has distinct source contacts and adjacent rebase. Do not apply both registrations or silently rename camera rows.
D1/D6 and other thick exterior foundation/frame pieces are expressly forbidden substitutions for these indoor assemblies without own evidence.
Base generated shabby G10/G1 pairing is an explicit new proposal with zero recovered occurrences; do not present it as recovered vendor compatibility.
